	type = country_event

	outcome = positive
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior 10 = happy }
	immediate = {
		event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:crown_estate background = estate_type:nobles_estate }
		set_variable = { name = oe_wp35_ev_cd value = 1 days = 75 }
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_wp35_civ.21.a
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 45
			modifier = { factor = 1.6 trigger = { gold >= 180 } }
		}
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		culture = { add_cultural_tradition = 4 }
		if = {
			limit = { owns = location:constantinople }
			location:constantinople = { change_control = 0.06 change_prosperity = 0.05 change_development = 0.25 }
		}
		else = {
			capital ?= { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes owner ?= root } change_control = 0.05 change_prosperity = 0.04 change_development = 0.20 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_wp35_civ_tur_s3_path }
			if = {
				limit = { var:oe_wp35_civ_tur_s3_path = 1 }
				ruler ?= { add_adm = 2 }
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_wp35_civ.21.b
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 30
			modifier = { factor = 1.8 trigger = { gold < 160 } }
		}
		add_gold = 115
		add_legitimacy = legitimacy_weak_bonus
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_wp35_civ_tur_s3_path }
			if = {
				limit = { var:oe_wp35_civ_tur_s3_path = 2 }
				add_army_tradition = army_tradition_weak_bonus
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_wp35_civ.21.c
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 25
			modifier = { factor = 2.0 trigger = { stability < 35 } }
		}
		add_stability = stability_mild_bonus
		ruler ?= { add_dip = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { owns = location:constantinople }
			location:constantinople = { change_prosperity = 0.06 }
		}
		else = {
			capital ?= { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes owner ?= root } change_prosperity = 0.05 } }
		}
	}
}

		}

		name = oe_wp35_civ.15.b
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 25
			modifier = { factor = 1.8 trigger = { stability < 30 } }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_wp35_mod_civ_spa_casa_contratacion years = 15 mode = replace }

	}

			modifier = { factor = 1.7 trigger = { gold < 160 } }

# Western European System: Casa de Contratación & Silver Fleet Audit
oe_wp35_civ.16 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_wp35_civ.16.title
	desc = oe_wp35_civ.16.desc
	outcome = neutral
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior 10 = regular }
	immediate = {
		event_illustration_estate_effect = { foreground = estate_type:burghers_estate background = estate_type:crown_estate }
		set_variable = { name = oe_wp35_ev_cd value = 1 days = 75 }
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_wp35_civ.16.a
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 55
			modifier = { factor = 1.6 trigger = { gold >= 200 } }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_wp35_mod_civ_spa_casa_contratacion years = 15 mode = replace }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp35_spawned_olivares } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_wp35_spawned_olivares value = 1 }
			create_character = {
				first_name = oe_wp35_fn_gaspar last_name = oe_wp35_ln_de_olivares female = no age = 37 trait_category = general adm = { 78 92 } dip = { 76 90 } mil = { 70 84 } estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
				culture = root.culture
				religion = root.religion
			}
		}
		else = {
			add_prestige = 6
			ruler ?= { add_adm = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owns = location:sevilla }
			location:sevilla = { change_control = 0.05 change_prosperity = 0.05 }
		}
		else = {
			capital ?= { if = { limit = { has_owner = yes owner ?= root } change_control = 0.04 change_prosperity = 0.04 } }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_wp35_civ.16.b
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 25
			modifier = { factor = 1.8 trigger = { stability < 30 } }
		}
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_wp35_mod_civ_spa_tercio_doctrine years = 15 mode = replace }
		add_prestige = 6
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_wp35_civ.16.c
		ai_chance = {
			factor = 20
			modifier = { factor = 1.7 trigger = { gold < 160 } }
		}
		add_gold = 110
		add_stability = 3
		ruler ?= { add_dip = 2 }
	}
}
